proposals.description: One row per migration key: pref:<scope>:<matter>, ledger:<scope> or rules.

matter.description: The preference matter; null for a ledger or the rules page.

entries.description: Ledger entries proposed; null for a page proposal.

status.description: planned only on a dry run; suppressed when dismissal memory holds a matching proposal.

id.description: The proposal task; null when planned.

pending.description: Open v1 #pending lines, reported for the user to turn into to-dos; never filed.

skipped_private.description: Lines in private SCRs or conversations, never copied into a proposal.

skipped_invalid.description: Decision lines the ledger would refuse (for example a time without an offset).
